title: #093. Iterative Subtour Elimination Cuts (DFJ TSP)
subtitle: Solve symmetric TSP from a 2-matching relaxation by iteratively separating disconnected subtours with Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson cuts.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { tour, totalDistance, iterations }.
judge.m1: iterations must be a positive integer (received {p0}).
judge.m2: tour[{p0}] must be an integer city index in 0..{p2} (received {p1}).
judge.m3: City {p0} appears more than once in tour (not a valid Hamiltonian cycle).
judge.m4: Reported totalDistance ({p0}) does not match computed tour length ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid Hamiltonian tour, but totalDistance ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
